text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: latency_slo_p99_burn fired for service=inference-api region=eu-west-2 window=5m count=28

alice: Acked the PD alert. I'm on it. Starting quick triage.

bob-oncall: thx alice. can you confirm which backbone is spiking? UI traces show p95 up too.

alice: Checking metrics now. p95 jumped ~2x, p99 ~4x. Spike concentrated on /v1/chat and /v1/generate routes. Most errors are latency > 3s, not 5xx.

carlos_sre: looks like KV cache eviction rate spiked around the same time. I see increased eviction ops on sidecar nodes in eu-west-2b.

alice: interesting — could be memory pressure from requests with long context sizes. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-14T09:04:12Z "runtime:opt-kernel-bump" -> prod-eu-west-2 completed by dana-runtime

dana-runtime: I rolled a tweak to the kernel selection heuristics 10m ago that's supposed to help throughput. rolling it back now since it coincides with the window.

bob-oncall: good call. while rollback is in progress, we should reduce tail by routing heavy customers off the shared pool. emma, can you flag any paying customers in beta/alpha who might be affected?

emma-support: Checked. Two beta accounts (acme-inc, search-labs) have heavy traffic on chat. I've DM'd both asking to shift non-critical jobs. ACME says they can throttle for 30m. Search-labs on a scheduled job — asked them to pause.

alice: rollback started. also temporarily set max_batch_tokens=1024 and disable continuous batch aggregation on the eu-west-2 pool to reduce queuing latency.

carlos_sre: I'm increasing sidecar mem limit and forcing a GC window to clear KV churn on three nodes. running the script:```bash
./tools/sre/fix_kv_eviction.sh --region eu-west-2 --targets node-43,node-47,node-51
```

bob-oncall: leaving a note: if rollback + mem bump doesn't help in 5m, we escalate PD to team-lead.

15m_check (alice): rollback finished @ 3098765490. initial metrics show p95 dipped ~30% but p99 still elevated. evictions down but not zero.

carlos_sre: confirmed, evictions reduced 60%. I think the runtime change reduced kernel-level prioritization of small batches causing larger KV churn.

dana-runtime: new plan: pin heavy routes to dedicated pool "dedicated-small-v2" for 10 minutes while we let caches warm. Applying route override:```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "match": {"customer_tags": ["beta"]},
  "destination": "dedicated-small-v2",
  "ttl": 600
}
```

alice: route override applied. verify traffic shift?

carlos_sre: traffic table shows ~12% of requests moved off the main pool — those are the heaviest customers. p95 improved further. p99 still has a thin tail at ~5s.

bob-oncall: what's the customer impact? any errors surfaced to end-users?

emma-support: ACME reported intermittent slow responses in their dashboard; no increased error rates. I told them we're mitigating and will follow up after 30m.

alice: root cause hypothesis: runtime heuristics changed kernel scheduling, increased latency for long-context requests that exacerbate KV cache evictions and cause tail amplification. mitigation: rollback + route pin + mem bump + temporary batch tuning.

dana-runtime: planning a small runtime patch to avoid de-prioritizing small-batch kernels. will open PR and test in staging.

carlos_sre: for immediate safety, I'm adding an autoscale step-up for inference-pool-eu-west-2b: +2 GPUs for 15m to absorb burst.```bash
./infra/autoscaler scale --pool inference-pool-eu-west-2b --delta 2 --ttl 900
```

deploy-bot: autoscale request queued, provisioning 2x A100-equivalent. ETA ~3m.

alice: good. if p99 doesn't drop below SLO within 20m we escalate PD to oncall-lead for possible customer-impact page.

20m_check (bob-oncall): autoscaler came up, p95 back near baseline, p99 reduced but still ~1.8x above target for a small subset of heavy requests.

alice: i'm going to run a targeted traffic replay in staging with representative long-context requests to validate the kernel patch. dana, can you prioritize the PR?

dana-runtime: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/merge-requests/462. tagging for expedited review.

carlos_sre: monitoring looks stable; eviction rates low. retaining route pin and batch limits for another 15m.

emma-support: updating customers: "We've applied temporary mitigations; performance should be improving. We'll follow up with post-incident notes."

alice: good. I'll keep the thread live and handoff to bob-oncall in 30m for follow-up/close if stable. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

bob-oncall: acked handoff. I'll watch for any PagerDuty re-triggers and coordinate postmortem if we see recurrence.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident latency_slo_p99_burn acknowledged by alice at 3098765440

--- end thread ---
